items:
Welcome to A Sun of a Beach, a spacious two-story vacation home located in Beach Retreat Cottages in Destin, Florida. Perfect for families and groups, this inviting three-bedroom, three-bathroom home comfortably sleeps up to ten guests and offers the ideal setting for a memorable Gulf Coast getaway. With bright living spaces, multiple flat-screen TVs, complimentary adult bicycles, easy access to the community pool and just 224 yards to the beach, this home combines comfort, convenience, and coastal charm for a relaxing stay.

The fully equipped kitchen comes complete with everything you need to whip up a quick beach snack or prepare a full gourmet dinner. Featuring modern appliances, ample counter space, and all the essential cookware and dishes, it’s easy to gather and enjoy meals together. The adjacent dining area and open living space create a welcoming atmosphere, perfect for sharing meals, playing games, or relaxing after a day in the sun.

This thoughtfully designed two-level home provides plenty of space for everyone to spread out and unwind. The first floor features the main living area along with a guest bedroom and full bathroom, while the second floor hosts the remaining bedrooms, including the private primary suite with an adjoining bathroom featuring a whirlpool tub and separate walk-in shower. Additional sleeping accommodations are available in the living area, making it easy to comfortably host your group.

Guests staying at A Sun of a Beach enjoy access to the wonderful amenities within Beach Retreat Cottages. Take a refreshing dip in the community pool, relax in the hot tub, or keep up with your fitness routine at the on-site fitness facility. The neighborhood also offers a grill area perfect for cooking up your fresh catch after a day of fishing. With beautifully maintained grounds and easy beach access nearby, you’ll find plenty of ways to relax and enjoy the coastal lifestyle.

Destin is known for its sugar-white sand beaches and emerald-green Gulf waters, and you’ll be perfectly positioned to enjoy it all. Spend your days lounging on the beach, exploring local restaurants and seafood spots, or shopping at nearby boutiques and outlets. With scenic bike rides, water activities, and family-friendly attractions just minutes away, there’s always something new to discover along the Emerald Coast.

Start planning your escape to A Sun of a Beach today and experience the best of Destin living. Whether you're seeking relaxation, adventure, or a little bit of both, this welcoming beach home is the perfect place to create lasting vacation memories.

description: Located in Miramar Beach, this vacation home is on the beach. Big Kahuna's Water and Adventure Park is a popular attraction and the area's natural beauty can be seen at Miramar Beach and Destin Beaches. Rainforest Black Light Golf & Arcade and Fat Daddy's Arcade are also worth visiting. Jet skiing, kayaking, and scuba diving offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with cycling nearby.
